name: EDC Las Vegas 2026
_note: Per-festival config consumed by scripts/festival_factory. Every value is grounded in the official 10_clean source (insomniac_official 'Nine Main Stages' + edc_guides_aggregated). Spatial/set-time fields are intentionally absent — not in source (Insomniac-app-only). Drop venue_map.json / set_times.jsonl beside this file to light up those relations.
_confusable_note: Facts the eval/cosine show collapsing into one basin. The hydrator gives each group a DISJOINT context world (never co-mentioning another group) and the geometry probe measures the confusable-pair cosine here. Membership is festival DATA; the distinctive vocabulary lives in scripts/pipeline/disjoint_context.py keyed by `key`.

kinetic_field.rank: the largest stage — EDC's iconic main stage, ~70,000 capacity, the largest stage in North America
kinetic_field.vibe: the iconic main stage with the owl mascot, hosting the biggest-name headliners

cosmic_meadow.vibe: home of EDC's Friday 5pm opening ceremony; all genres, live performances, some hip-hop and rock

circuit_grounds.vibe: renowned for LED walls and plumes of fire

neon_garden.vibe: the dark, deep techno stage with minimalism and immersive live art

basspod.genre: dubstep, bass house, drum and bass, and trap
basspod.vibe: the proving ground of the Bassrush massive, where headbangers go hard

wasteland.vibe: the post-apocalyptic Basscon universe of blistering tempos

quantum_valley.vibe: where the Trance Fam gathers; Dreamstate presents the entire trance spectrum

stereo_bloom.genre: house, tech house, and bass music
stereo_bloom.vibe: the diverse house/tech-house stage of known artists and up-and-comers

bionic_jungle.rank: a small but mighty stage (EDC's newest stage)
bionic_jungle.vibe: a journey deep into the wild with a curated roster of house artists
